grammarFocus: 比较结构、数量表达与指代综合；冠词和主谓一致检查。
title: The Pool Training Data Puzzle
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。文章和题目均为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思试题。请仔细阅读，注意比较结构、数量表达和指代；同时检查冠词和主谓一致。答案必须来自原文。
passage:
At the Westbridge Community Pool, the head coach, Maria, was reviewing the training data from the last eight weeks. She had collected numbers on attendance, lap times, and the number of lengths each swimmer completed. Her goal was to understand how the training programme was working and to decide what to change for the next stage.

The data showed some clear patterns. In Week 1, the average swimmer completed 40 lengths per session. By Week 8, that number had risen to 55 lengths. However, the improvement was not the same for everyone. The younger swimmers, aged 12 to 14, improved more quickly than the older ones. Their average lap time dropped by 12 seconds, while the older group's lap time dropped by only 5 seconds.

Maria also looked at attendance. Overall, attendance was higher in the second half of the programme than in the first half. In Weeks 1–4, an average of 18 swimmers came to each session. In Weeks 5–8, the figure was 22. But when she looked more closely, she noticed that the Friday evening sessions had the lowest attendance of all. Only 10 to 12 swimmers usually attended those sessions, compared with 25 on Tuesday evenings.

One swimmer, Tom, had missed several sessions because of a knee injury. His data was incomplete, so Maria did not include his results in the group averages. She knew that including incomplete data could make the overall picture misleading. 'We need to be careful with numbers,' she told her assistant. 'A single missing value can change the average more than you expect.'

Maria decided to compare two groups: those who attended at least 80% of sessions and those who attended less than 60%. The high-attendance group improved their lap times by an average of 10 seconds. The low-attendance group improved by only 3 seconds. This suggested that attendance was strongly linked to improvement. However, Maria reminded herself that this did not prove that attendance caused the improvement. Other factors, such as motivation or previous training, might also play a role.

For the next stage, Maria planned to make several changes. First, she would move the Friday session to an earlier time to see if more swimmers could attend. Second, she would add a short technique session for the older swimmers, because their progress had been slower. Third, she would keep a separate record for swimmers with injuries so that their data would not affect the group averages.

Maria also wanted to improve how the data was recorded. In the past, coaches wrote times on paper, and some numbers were difficult to read. Now, she would use a simple spreadsheet. Each swimmer's lengths and lap times would be entered after every session. She would also add a column for 'notes' to record any special circumstances, such as illness or injury.

Finally, Maria presented her findings to the swimmers and their parents. She used simple charts to show the trends. She explained that the programme was working well overall, but that there were areas for improvement. She asked the swimmers for their opinions. Several swimmers said they preferred morning sessions. Others said they liked the Friday evening time because it was convenient after school. Maria listened carefully and wrote down their comments.

In the end, Maria felt more confident about using data to make decisions. She realised that numbers alone do not tell the whole story. Context, careful recording, and listening to people's experiences were just as important as the statistics themselves.

grammar.title: 比较结构、数量表达与指代综合；冠词和主谓一致检查
grammar.explanation: 比较结构用来比较事物，如 more quickly than；数量表达如 an average of 18 swimmers；their 等代词要有明确的指代对象。the younger swimmers 用 the 特指已明确的那组人。主谓一致要核对单复数：data 在传统学术用法中视为复数，可接 were/have；现代英语也常将它视为一个不可数集合，接 was/has。两种用法都存在，不能脱离语境把其中一种一律判错。showed 是一般过去式，单复数主语后形式相同，不能靠它判断主谓一致。
grammar.example: The younger swimmers, aged 12 to 14, improved more quickly than the older ones.

options: The number of swimmers have increased.
The number of swimmers has increased.
A number of swimmers has increased.
The number of swimmer has increased.
answers: The number of swimmers has increased.
questions.explanation: 'the number of' 作主语时谓语用单数，因此用 has。

options: She is more faster than her brother.
She is faster than her brother.
She is more fast than her brother.
She is fastest than her brother.
answers: She is faster than her brother.
questions.explanation: fast 的比较级是 faster，前面不加 more。
'each' 作主语时谓语用单数，因此用 has。

questions.prompt: 本题限定采用传统学术英语中 data 作复数的用法，描述上周已结束的采集。选择唯一符合两项要求的句子：
options: The data were collected by the coach last week.
The data was collected by the coach last week.
The data are collected by the coach last week.
The data were collect by the coach last week.
answers: The data were collected by the coach last week.
questions.explanation: 题干明确将 data 视为复数，且事件发生在上周，故用过去时复数 were；被动语态后接过去分词 collected。was 在将 data 视为不可数集合的语境中也可成立，但不符合本题限定的复数用法；are 不符合过去时间；collect 不是过去分词。
questions.evidence: The data were collected by the coach last week.
